anchor: Unnumbered paragraph after Theorem2.30 at end Section2.2.1, immediately before Section2.2.2 Analysis with Subgradients
faithful_restatement: Convexity on its domain does not imply differentiability except at at most countably many points: f:R2->R, f(x)=|x1| fails ambient differentiability at every point of the nondegenerate segment joining (0,0) and (0,1). That segment is uncountable, so the nondifferentiability locus is uncountable.
